note: Voiceover lines. Each line is synthesized to out/vo/<id>.wav by vo.py; timeline.js places them. 'gap' is the breathing space (seconds) after the line.

lines.text: You sent the deposit. The logo never came.
Or you did the work, and the money never came.
The payment worked. The promise didn't.
This is Kept. Money moves only when a promise is kept.
Describe the deal the way you'd text it.
Claude writes down what each side is owed, and the rules that move the money.
Then a verifier walks every possible path. Every delivery, every deadline, every review.
Here, it caught a real bug. Deliver on time, and the designer could still lose two hundred dollars.
So the rules get repaired. Never your promises. Proved, across every outcome.
Both sides approve the same fingerprint.
Then the money is held by PayPal. Not by a stranger. Not by us.
The logo arrives. Maya accepts.
Three hundred dollars, released exactly as proved.
Every cent leaves a signed trail. So try to rewrite it.
Two hundred becomes two thousand. Broken.
Even if you cover your tracks. Not even we can rewrite it.
Now give an AI agent a budget, not your card.
Paper, paid. Toner, it asks you first. A chair over the limit, denied. A shop you never allowed, denied.
Close the budget, and every unused dollar comes home.
Say it. Prove it. Hold it. Keep it.
Kept.
